name: a Counter wired into itself is broken by the breaker, not thrown, and carries on next frame
because: C9 — 500 sends on one output within an iteration trip `_cyclicLoop` (outputproperty.ts :130-137) and the node is re-flagged for the next frame through `scheduleNextFrame` = once('frameStart') (node.ts :629-644, nodecontext.ts :548-551) instead of the app freezing. Count Changed into its own Increase runs until the breaker. The numbers are the limits read through this graph: the direct Increase counts 1 and pulses once; each frame's drain then processes pulses until the 502nd send of the frame trips the breaker (the counter resets per update iteration and trips on `> 500`), so a frame adds 502; a settle is two frames (the target's shape, node-spec-target.ts). 1 + 502 + 502 = 1005 at the second settle, + 1004 = 2009 at the third — and the third settle moving at all is the re-flag: a target that never re-arms a tripped node stops at 503; a target with no breaker never returns from settle.
